neighbours.label: spatial preposition right after a physical-event verb: where a thing was done to something (buried near, hanged beside, shot behind)
fire: The rebels were shot beside the church and their bodies left there.
The spider devoured a cricket inside its glass jar.
The deer was killed near the river by a hunter.
The traitors were beheaded behind the castle gate.
The thief was caught beneath the old railway bridge.
The ox was slaughtered outside the temple by the priest.
The horses were tied beside the well before the raid.
The body was dumped behind the warehouse by two men.
quiet: The rebels were shot at dawn and their bodies left there.
The spider devoured a cricket very quickly last night.
The deer was killed by a hunter with a rifle.
The traitors were beheaded for their crime.
The thief was caught yesterday by the police.
The ox was slaughtered by the priest for the feast.
The horses were tied with rope before the raid.
The body was dumped by two men in the night.

notes: Probes: beside 0.68, behind 0.61, near 0.52, inside 0.40; static descriptions under 0.04. ' later' reached only 0.07 and ' during' 0.19, so temporal adjuncts are weaker. Near misses keep the verb and swap the place for time, agent or manner.
